text: {"intents": [{"activity": "confront_wrecker", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "13:30", "why": "Corvin pulled down the whole hut I just built not half an hour ago, and I mean to stand in front of them and let them see I have not forgotten it."}, {"activity": "gather_stone", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "15:30", "why": "The hut takes 6660096 units of stone and I hold only 1728512, so I need to cut more from the pile beside my plot before I can build anything."}, {"activity": "build_hut", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "17:00", "why": "My plot at (25, 510, 36) is empty now and the limestone I carry is enough, so once the stone is cut I will put the small hut back up."}, {"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "18:30", "why": "After all that, I will stand beside the new hut and keep an eye on it, since the one who took the last one is still nearby."}], "tasks": {"open": [{"goal": "Rebuild the small hut on my plot at (25, 510, 36) and keep it standing this time.", "why": "I built it once already today and Corvin took it apart, and I will not leave my plot empty.", "steps": [{"activity": "gather_stone", "object": null, "why": "I need far more stone than I hold before a hut can be raised."}, {"activity": "build_hut", "object": null, "why": "With stone and limestone in hand I can put the hut back on my plot."}, {"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "why": "Standing by it afterwards is the only way I can keep an eye on what happens to it."}]}], "drop": []}, "cannot_yet": [{"want": "Get a straight answer out of Corvin about why they tore my hut down.", "why": "One act told me nothing about their reasons, and I would rather know than keep guessing at them."}]}
